# SublimApparel

> Yiwu-based sublimation printing factory for B2B buyers in North America and Europe. Dye-sublimation on polyester, all-over DTG on 100% cotton, low MOQ, DDP-to-door logistics.

## About

SublimApparel is a clothing manufacturer based in Yiwu, China, specializing in full-coverage dye-sublimation printing on polyester and 100% cotton apparel. We supply event organizers, marketing teams, agencies, and e-commerce brands with custom-printed apparel in small to mid-sized runs (MOQ 50 pcs).

Production capabilities cover the full pipeline: in-house pattern making, digital printing (dye-sublimation, DTG/DTF), cutting, sewing, quality inspection, and packing. We handle DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) shipping to most US, Canadian, UK, and EU destinations — buyer does not deal with customs or last-mile.

## Core capabilities

- Dye sublimation printing on polyester (all-over full-bleed, no color limit)
- DTG (Direct-to-Garment) printing on 100% cotton for all-over full-bleed prints
- DTF (Direct-to-Film) transfers for small runs and varied placements
- Cut & sew from blank fabric (sublimation) or pre-made garments (DTG/DTF)
- Custom labels, tags, hang tags, poly-bag, and retail-ready packaging
- Sourcing of blanks: polyester jersey, polyester mesh, 100% cotton jersey, French terry, fleece
- Screen printing, embroidery, and heat-transfer for chest / sleeve logos
- Sample service (paid sample with refund on bulk order)

## Products (6 main categories)

1. T-Shirts — short-sleeve crew-neck / V-neck, polyester or cotton
2. Polo Shirts — collar, 3-button placket
3. Hoodies & Sweatshirts — pullover, zip-up, hooded
4. Jerseys — full-button baseball, full-button softball, soccer, rugby, basketball
5. Tank Tops & Sleeveless — running, basketball, beach
6. Long-Sleeve Tees & Performance Wear — compression, base layer, fishing

Other categories: shorts, leggings, bandanas, hats, socks, scarves, tote bags, flags, banners.

## Services & differentiators

- **Low MOQ**: 50 pieces per design, mixed sizes allowed
- **All-over full-bleed print**: edge-to-edge sublimation, no white borders
- **DDP shipping**: door-to-door with all duties, taxes, and last-mile included
- **Sample in 5-7 days**: paid sample, refundable against bulk order
- **Bulk lead time 7-15 days**: depending on quantity and complexity
- **Free design service**: artwork mockup and color separation provided
- **Multiple printing methods**: sublimation, DTG, DTF, screen print, embroidery

## Industries served

- Event festivals & conferences (staff + participant apparel)
- Endurance races (marathon, triathlon, cycling jerseys)
- Corporate / brand merchandise
- Sports teams (baseball, soccer, basketball, rugby, esports)
- Schools, universities, summer camps
- Political campaigns
- Promotional distributors / agencies
- E-commerce brands (POD platforms, Shopify sellers)
- Music festivals, tours, fan merchandise

## Process

1. Inquiry — buyer sends design + quantity + delivery target
2. Quotation — unit price, shipping cost, lead time, payment terms
3. Sample (optional) — paid sample shipped in 5-7 days
4. Deposit — typically 30% T/T deposit to start production
5. Production — 7-15 days after deposit + artwork approval
6. Quality check — pre-shipment inspection photos
7. Final payment — 70% balance before shipping
8. DDP shipping — by air or sea, door delivery with duties paid
